name: bstack
description: Beau's rigorous agent workflow. beau-mode routes each task to a playbook and the principles; skills for understanding (how, why, teach, recall), proof (verify-work, create- and maintain-verification-skill, create- and maintain-formal-verification-skill, swarm), design and planning (architect, arena, state-machines, technical-writing), product repos (scaffold-product and the Product phase playbook), review and trails (interrogate, show-me-your-work), and improvement (reflect, correct, unslop) do the steps. Adapted from Lauren Tan's pstack to work in any agent.
